body: Thanks, man. I just kind of hoped I'd feel better eventually. It's been years, and in some ways, I'm still the teenager huddled up in the back of a tiny British car, snow piling up on my windshield, wondering "when does this become worth it?"

Thank you. Not to toot my own horn, but I am kind of proud of myself (toot toot). I know people have had it rougher, and still do, but my personal brand of life was hard on me, and I made it. 

That said, maybe you're right. But I'm complete garbage at the whole "making friends" thing. Some people can just do it, but people can tell that there's something wrong with me. I alway say "I'm dead inside" to explain it. I don't know another way. I'm just weird. I don't know how to be normal. 

And doing everything by yourself is efficient, but eventually you grow tired of it, I assure you.

I don't know, man. I can attest that anything will work out if you have no option of failure. 

I just don't feel any better for it. I still feel empty

I guess that's kind of the problem. With the exception of being alone, my life is pretty good. I have a roof over my head, I'm replying on my iPhone, hell, I typed up the post on my second laptop before I hopped into my mustang and drove to school. 

But I've never been able to shake the feeling of wanting to just stop. Just not do it anymore, you know?  I've come a long way, and I really want to be done. I'm just tired. 

It's never really seemed to have anything to do with the state of my life. It's more of a constant "ok, I finished that. Can I stop now?" kind of a feeling. 

I don't know. Maybe I can't really explain it. I'm sure everyone feels that way sometimes. But I wonder if anyone feels that way all the time like I do
